notes: MLS Assist v1.40 - FIXES the Seamless Athena overlay + ADDS user-initiated Sign & Save. The overlay's detect/pull adapters were bound to internal names that were never implemented, so it could never see the open patient or pull history and sat stuck on 'Open a patient in Athena' with a washed-out button. v1.40 wires the overlay to the proven in-production engines: it now reliably DETECTS the open athenaOne patient (read-only), the 'Read this patient & pull the full history' action works end to end, and the overlay text/buttons are high-contrast and legible (no ghost text). NEW Sign & Save: when YOU click Sign & Save (in the overlay's 'written' step, or from the MLS web app), the extension re-checks the name+DOB patient gate, writes the verified note if needed, then auto-clicks athenaOne's Sign & Save - and reports 'signed' ONLY when Athena actually confirms the save/sign. It never signs autonomously, never on an unconfirmed patient, and never fakes success. All other behavior unchanged: read-only except the gated note write/sign; the patient name+DOB gate stays enforced. Download and reload at chrome://extensions to update.
